paras: Heliobolus neumanni, also known commonly as Neumann's sand lizard, is a species of lizard in the family Lacertidae. The species is endemic to East Africa.
Heliobolus neumanni is found in Ethiopia, Kenya, and Tanzania.
The specific name, neumanni, is in honor of German ornithologist Oscar Neumann.
The preferred natural habitat of Heliobolus neumanni is savanna, at altitudes from sea level to 1,500 m (4,900 ft).
